notes.title: Nocturnals has over 11,000 Wishlists!
notes.content:
[h1]Nocturnals currently has over 11,000 wishlists! [/h1]

This is incredible! Thank you so much to everyone supporting the game! And thank you once again for all the feedback! Your feedback, both positive & negative, helps me to improve my game - [b]so it’s all really appreciated.
[/b]

There will be a gameplay trailer released in the next month, and I can’t wait for you guys to play the full game!

Development is going well, and I’m still aiming for an end of summer release.

I regularly post little sneak peeks / dev logs in the discord server we have for Cowboy Toad Games, feel free to [url=https://discord.gg/KHe26tvSVR]join![/url]

[h1]Thank you all for over 4000 wishlists![/h1]

At the start of the month, I was thanking you all for 400 wishlists, which was incredible to me at the time. Now, less than a month later, I can't believe I'm able to thank you for 4,000! I'm so grateful to every single one of you for reading, interacting, and leaving feedback. Even the negative comments have been helpful, and I'm so happy you guys are sticking around. I can't wait to share this story with you all!

notes.title: Thank you for over 400 wishlists!
notes.content:
Hey everyone! Just want to thank you all for 400 wishlists! That's incredible! 

I woke up this morning to see 300 new wish lists after Alpha-Beta Gamer posted a playthrough of the Demo on his YouTube channel. You can find it here!

[previewyoutube=mMInU5Sb_U0;full][/previewyoutube]

The Demo shall be released publicly around the beginning of June. Just a week ahead of Next Fest. It will be an awesome opportunity to hear everyone's feedback.

So far the comments on his video seem mostly positive! There were a few that gave me a good laugh. 

I really value everyone's feedback and read everything everyone says. I noticed one person said they hoped there would be accessibility options. 

So far I have:

[list]
[*]Story Hints
[*]Subtitles 
[*]Mouse/Controller Sensitivity options
[/list]

Has anyone got any suggestions of some more accessibility features they feel would be an important addition?


Thanks again everyone,

Max :)

notes.title: Nocturnals is on track for a Summer 2024 release!
notes.content:
Hello everyone! I hope you've all had a great new year so far.

Just wanted to drop in and let you all know that Nocturnals development is going smoothly. I've not missed any set deadlines for myself so far within the development, and with that in mind my predicted release date is around August 2024. (Not confirmed or set in stone!)

Nocturnals is almost at 100 wishlists! Thank you everyone! Your support means the world to me, and each new wishlist gives me such a boost in productivity! 

Nocturnals has also been entered in a couple summer game dev competitions, so we've got that to look forward to as well. 

Thank you everyone for your continued support!

- Max

notes.title: Welcome to Nocturnals!
notes.content:
Hello everyone! 
Max here,

Welcome to the Nocturnals steam page! 

From now on, all major updates/events will be posted here or on our Instagram account @CowboyToadGames. 

[b]Coming up:[/b]

I'm so excited to share more content with you all! Coming up I am hoping to provide content creators with the first 10 minutes of the game, which will allow you all to get a better look at the game-play and atmosphere (and hopefully build excitement).

[b]About us:[/b]

For those who don't know, this is our first published game! And CowboyToadGames is comprised of two Students, Max and Pablo who do video game developing as a hobby. Other than that, Pablo also enjoys creating music and I enjoy surfing, we also both enjoy watching video game essays together!

Nocturnals is my idea of a love letter to my boyfriend Pablo, who I appreciate very dearly, and he has been such a great help on this project - with music and voice acting - and is currently in the middle of creating his own game too. 

Our friends have also been such a great help with the project, with two of them lending their voice acting talents towards the project as well! (Thanks Becca and Leah). 

I can't wait to share more with you guys!

Happy Holidays :)

- CowboyToadGames
